answer: Sybil resistance requires each claimed identity to complete a verifiable sequence of modular squarings, with every result depending on the previous one. GPUs can process separate clones concurrently, but cannot parallelize a single Wesolowski VDF chain to eliminate its sequential delay; each added identity still requires computation and time. Like a harbor reached by a narrow wharf, identities cannot be created instantly, and the final result bears the pigment of completed work.
